algorithms.classification: TikTok rules plus raw-IP/443 fast high-uplink promotion
algorithms.reorder: 32-sample late-ACK/spurious window, P95/P99, minimum 8 samples, fast raise and slow decay
algorithms.loss: effective loss excludes spurious; media requires at least 20 MTU and two material-loss RTTs
algorithms.bbr_media_recovery: bw_lo floor 70%, inflight_lo floor 60%, recovery at most one effective RTT
algorithms.cubic_limit: hard clamp to cwin_max; media repeat-loss reduces at most once per RTT with a 50% prior-cwin floor
algorithms.media_pacing: 2 MTU bucket; retransmission is paced separately; datagrams use media-first round-robin and a 200ms stale deadline
algorithms.runtime_classification: 1s windows; sustained ctrl above 128Kbps demotes to bulk; unknown uplink above 256Kbps promotes to media
algorithms.observability: queue age plus event-loop busy/wake lag; linkq grouped by run/worker/cid
algorithms.ack_only_loss_filter: ACK-only packets are excluded from effective loss and congestion notification on every loss-detection path

validation.remaining: repeat during the historically unstable afternoon window and run viewer-side quality sampling
